gates.detail: The check completed and established that no runtime/static fixture existed.
The available machine does not match the owner-approved reference tier.
Available OS, CPU, RAM, GPU, driver, and machine identity metadata were captured; unavailable fields are null with reasons.
Resolution and refresh were captured, but exact Windows scaling and the required 60 Hz configuration were not established.
The active power plan was captured; AC state, thermals, vendor settings, and process controls were not.
Active adapter metadata was captured, but isolation/shaping controls were not applied.
Available Edge, Firefox, PowerShell, Git, and Node versions and unavailable Chrome/npm/npx/Playwright states were recorded.
Headless Edge obtained WebGL2 on non-reference hardware, but target hardware acceleration was not established and GPU errors occurred.
The rAF probe did not complete and no p95 value exists.
Firefox was available and version-captured but was not exercised.
Chrome was unavailable in the searched locations.
Real Safari hardware was unavailable; no certification is claimed.
